title: Bump bullframe theme to v6 classless
description:
## Summary
The vendored **bullframe** theme is still classless **v4.0.1** from `master`. Upstream is now **bullframe.css@6.0.0** (native CSS / PostCSS, no Sass).

Request: refresh `data-raw/themes.yml` + `inst/resources/bullframe/` to the v6 classless min build (and map), then re-run `data-raw/gather-css.R` so `R/sysdata.rda` matches.

- Docs: https://bullframecss.marcopontili.com
- Classless: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bullframe.css@6.0.0/dist/css/bullframe-classless.min.css`
- Maintainer of bullframe.css; will open a PR with the YAML/CSS bump.

title: Use cleanrmd for vignettes in cleanrmd
update latex.css with new font integrated in origin repo
description:
Vincent Doerig's github repo that contains the template for the `latex.css` theme has a new font integrated (Libertinus, see [here](https://github.com/vincentdoerig/latex-css/tree/master/fonts)).

This font however is not downloaded autmatically when installing the `cleanrmd` package which causes knitting to fail.

title: cleanrmd forces left alignment on screen
description:
Hi, 

Thank you for this package. cleanrmd forces my markdown file to appear on the left of the screen, instead of the centre. The issue is not present when I use

cleanrmd::html_document_clean:
    theme: NULL
    
But it is present whenever I specify a theme, e.g.:

output: 
  cleanrmd::html_document_clean:
    theme: water-dark
